## Evidence boundary

- Proves: physical and logical MAPINFO identities across all three Shenmue I discs.
- Proves: structurally valid AUTH/TRCK resources embedded in MAPINFO or stored as direct PKS/PKF IPAC members.
- Proves: AUTH payload identity, chunk layout, duration, actors, commands, and parse issues where supported by the shared parsers.
- Does not prove: which room-script route owns or launches each AUTH resource.
- Does not prove: that every AUTH resource is a distinct player-facing scene.
- Does not prove: complete AFS voice/model dependency resolution.
- Does not prove: runtime or gameplay completion.
